Market today: The mood is cautiously optimistic, driven by Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, which is a huge catalyst for your tech/chip-heavy book. Your leveraged ETFs are getting hammered, and even the broader market ETFs are down.

Your holdings: SMCI (-43.55%), SOXL (-80.75%), MUU (-63.97%), SPAL (-48.65%), PLTU (-35.15%), SMH (-27.53%), METU (-26.35%), SNOW (-18.34%), MSFU (-13.54%), QQQI (-13.25%), SPY (-1.48%), CRWD (17.3%). All are marked SELL or TRIM, indicating they need attention. The leveraged ETFs are particularly concerning due to decay and margin amplification.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia's continued reaction and any follow-through in semiconductor names. Also, watch the broader market ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for signs of stabilization or further decline.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your highly leveraged positions and protecting capital in this volatile environment.
plays: Trim METU if it breaks below 18.3. This leveraged ETF is showing significant losses and decay risk.
Consider trimming SMCI if it fails to hold current levels. The -43.55% loss is substantial, and margin amplifies downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
